test_title: PYST 24: Selection Post (Graduation Level) - Reasoning (Held On 1 Aug 2022 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
'A # B' means 'A is the brother of B'.

'A @ B' means 'A is the daughter of B'.

'A & B' means 'A is the husband of B'.

'A % B' means 'A is the wife of B'.

If V & R @ F % H # T @ M, then how is R related to M?
solution:
From the given information:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/abf25944776d2a3ecedfc8ce453d6240c47cfde66b9c3a1ec4348e9237131af8.png] 

V & R @ F % H # T @ M we get,

V is the husband of R, R is the daughter of F, F is the wife of H, H is the brother of T,
